prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Perfect Companion", "Select a pet based on their personality traits and daily desktop vibe.", "Playful & Energetic"]
1: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Your pet will live right on your desktop. Use system tray icons to show or hide anytime.", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon your pet immediately."]
2: ["Creating Your Custom Companion", "We are crafting your pet's animations and behavior rules.", "Finalizing pixel art and desktop physics..."]
3: ["Secure Your Pet & Progress", "Sign in to back up your pet customization across devices so you never lose your companion.", "Cloud Save Protected"]
4: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new pet an official name to seal the adoption record.", "Pet Name"]
5: ["Pick Your Companion Style in 10 Seconds", "Select a ready-made mascot or create a custom one. You can change your choice anytime later.", "No wrong choices — both options unlock full desktop features."]
6: ["For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting and simple backgrounds.", "PNG / JPG supported"]
7: ["Meet Your Pet on Your Desktop!", "Click and drag to move your pet around your screen. Right-click for options and mini-games.", "Right-click pet: Open Controls Menu\nDouble-click pet: Pet or feed mascot"]
8: ["Choose How to Meet Your Pet", "Explore companion styles below.", "Select Path"]
9: ["Almost Ready to Play!", "Your companion is getting ready to jump onto your desktop.", "Tip: You can pet your mascot by double-clicking it on your desktop.", "Desktop Pet Tips"]

verdicts.problem: Creates artificial urgency with a 10-second limit.
Asks for personal photos of the user.
